title: An in vivo assay to study locomotion in Caenorhabditis elegans
author: Abdelhack

steps.title: Prepare NGM buffer (1 L)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 3 g NaCl in 975 mL de‑ionized water, autoclave, then add 1 mL CaCl₂, 1 mL MgSO₄, and 25 mL KH₂PO₄ solution that has been adjusted to pH 6.000 with 5 M KOH; mix to a final volume of 1 L and verify the final pH (≈6.3).

substeps.instruction: Weigh 3 g NaCl and add to 975 mL H₂O in a suitable flask.
Autoclave the NaCl solution to sterilize.
Prepare a KH₂PO₄ solution and adjust its pH to 6.000 using 5 M KOH.
After autoclaving, add 1 mL CaCl₂, 1 mL MgSO₄, and 25 mL pH‑adjusted KH₂PO₄ to the cooled NaCl solution.
Mix thoroughly to a final volume of 1 L and record the measured pH (expected ≈6.3).

steps.title: Make 65 % dextran solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 65 g of dextran powder (MW 200 000, Wako Pure Chemical Industries Ltd., Japan) in 100 mL of the prepared NGM buffer, stir with an overhead stirrer (DLH, VELP Scientifica, Italy), then autoclave to eliminate air bubbles.

substeps.instruction: Add the dextran to 100 mL NGM buffer in a suitable vessel.
Stir the mixture using the DLH overhead stirrer until fully dissolved.
Autoclave the solution; the autoclave step also removes trapped air bubbles.

steps.title: Prepare 30 % dextran solution
steps.instruction: Create a 30 % dextran solution by mixing appropriate volumes of the 65 % dextran stock and NGM buffer, then homogenize the mixture by sonication.

substeps.instruction: Calculate the volumes needed to achieve a final dextran concentration of 30 % (e.g., mix 46.15 mL of 65 % dextran stock with 53.85 mL NGM buffer; exact proportional volumes may be adjusted accordingly).
Combine the calculated volumes of 65 % dextran solution and NGM buffer in a clean tube.
Sonicate the mixture until a uniform solution is obtained.
